scope: Cycles CPU studio review; concept/model evidence, not Unreal gameplay
limitations: Static crops and sampled clip poses do not prove continuous motion or engine appearance.
No generated geometry, bind matrices, skin weights, UVs or morphs are edited.
FBX clip previews use their own geometry where provided; otherwise action transfer requires matching own-body rest matrices.
Retained PBR maps are interpreted as supplied; normal-map Y orientation is not inferred.
